purpose: Descriptive cue-aligned scalp, eye-electrode and mechanical change in a single person's previously used development runs. Both earlier elbow and arm forecast results were known when this was specified. These summaries provide no confirmatory, held-out or predictive test.
event_validation: Require six onsets per cue per run; require unique matched end 1536 ticks later. An unexpected source identity, grid or event census fails the build.
indices: For an integer endpoint d in event ticks, index is ceil((cue_tick+d)*rate/512), using integer arithmetic. Bounds half-open. Keep native sampling and source reference. No interpolation, filtering, artifact removal, re-referencing, normalization or smoothing.
within_trial: For each channel and window, use the median of every stored sample in the postcue interval minus the median in the baseline interval. Require both intervals wholly inside the recording, nonempty and entirely finite. No imputation, outlier dropping or trial-wide cross-channel removal. Count exclusions separately by reason with precedence baseline bounds, baseline nonfinite, post bounds, post nonfinite. Count each excluded channel/trial/window once.
within_run: Median across the eligible repeats of the same cue for the same channel/window; require >=3 of six.
across_runs: Arithmetic mean of the three run medians with equal weights. Otherwise JSON null. Report count of eligible trials summed across runs, qualifying runs per cell and aggregate range of per-run repeat counts without publishing fitted or per-run signals.
palette: Across all finite EEG task x window x site changes only, sort absolute values and compute type-7 (linear) 95th percentile at 0.95*(N-1). Symmetric domain +/- that value. Count strict underflow and overflow. Preserve exact values in payload. EOG and mechanical channels retain measured numbers in their own unspecified stored scale; never combine scales.
source_labels: Scalp sites from author table 2, channels 1..61. EOG by index because table and header reverse lateral labels at 62 and 64. Hardware indices 93 elbow, 94 forearm rotation, 68 index-near.
interpretation: One participant, 18 cues per named task. Sensor-space observations may include ocular/muscle artifacts, reference effects and volume conduction. They do not localize cortical generators, identify intention, measure force or establish effects in other people. Native physical unit codes absent, stored physical scale factor one and offset zero; positive sign follows source, anatomical sign uncalibrated.
disclosure: Aggregate task/window/channel values and availability counts only. No raw traces, per-trial samples, per-run signal values or per-trial features.
verification: Compare every task, bin, site, eligible count and value against a separate direct GDF parser using independently coded reduction, also check every channel label against original PDF and palette statistics. Absolute tolerance 1e-10 with double precision; retain maximum absolute difference.
